 Chitwan takes on Sudurpaschim for a place in the final
 The Qualifier 2 match is scheduled to begin at 4:30 pm today. The winner will meet Lumbini Lions in the final at the same venue on Saturday.

 REPUBLICA
 KATHMANDU, Nov 19: Chitwan Rhinos and Sudurpaschim Royals will face off today for the second and final spot in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) 2026 final.
 The Qualifier 2 match will be played under lights at the TU International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, with Chitwan looking to carry the momentum from their emphatic win over Kathmandu Gorkhas on Wednesday and secure a place in Saturday’s final against Lumbini Lions.
 Related story 
 Lumbini Lions crowned NPL season 2 champions, Sudurpaschim fall...
 Chitwan stormed into Qualifier 2 after defeating Kathmandu Gorkhas by 61 runs in the eliminator. Batting first, Chitwan posted a massive 204 for four before restricting Kathmandu to a lower total.
 Sudurpaschim, meanwhile, will be aiming to return to the final for a second consecutive year after losing last year’s title clash to Lumbini Lions. They were beaten by Lumbini by six wickets in the first qualifier after managing only 105 for eight while batting first.
 The Qualifier 2 match is scheduled to begin at 4:30 pm today. The winner will meet Lumbini Lions in the final at the same venue on Saturday.
